name: Marie Light
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) (68.2%), Sugar, Refined Palm Oil, Invert Syrup, Raising Agents [INS 500 (ii), INS 503(ii), INS 450(i)], Milk Solids, lodized Salt, Flour treatment agent (INS 223), Nature identical flavouring substances, Artificial flavouring substances (Milk, Vanilla), Emulsifier [Diacetyl tartaric and fatty acid esters of glycerol (from sunflower and palm oil)], Mineral (0.01%), Colour (INS 150d) and Vitamins (0.01%). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SULPHITE. MAY CONTAINS NUT, SOY
